en: The image is a black-and-white, vintage postcard showing a group of men, apparently soldiers, in uniform gathered around an outdoor kitchen area. Some are seated, drinking or eating, while others appear to be preparing food. The setting includes rural stone buildings and rustic kitchen equipment. The printed text at the top identifies the scene as being from a military camp kitchen in Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier, France.
